name: Midtrans

google.heading: Midtrans on Google
google.summary: 329 reviews on the Jakarta listing and a 3.0 average that means almost nothing on its own, because the distribution is 159 five-star against 155 one-star with only 15 reviews in between. Two populations, no middle. Note also that a large share of the reviews on this listing are in Indonesian and machine-translated by Google, and a translation is not the reviewer's words, so the summary here rests on the English ones. Those split cleanly. The praise is from small Jakarta merchants describing an easy integration, a wide set of local payment methods and a dashboard that made reconciliation simple. The complaints are about the two ends of the relationship: approval taking well over a month with vague or absent replies, and funds held after a declined transaction, including one merchant told 180 days.

themes.label: Local payment methods and easy integration
themes.detail: The consistent praise from Indonesian merchants: the methods their customers actually use, wired up without much work.

themes.label: Approval times
themes.detail: Described as among the longest of any gateway these merchants have used, with more than one account stuck over a month and a half in review.

themes.label: Holds after a declined transaction
themes.detail: One merchant describes unrelated funds held over a single declined payment, and being told the hold could run 180 days.

themes.label: Read the English reviews
themes.detail: Much of this listing is machine-translated from Indonesian. A translation is not what the reviewer wrote, so it is excluded here.

quotes.text: The Customer Service is possibly the worst i have seen in the world. Significant delays, no gaurntee of reply, no acountability, vague and incomplete instructions for onbaording and etc.

As a small business owner in Jakarta, I've been using Midtrans for our online payment processing, and I couldn't be happier! Their platform is incredibly user-friendly, making it easy to integrate payments into our e-commerce site.

noRedditReason: Midtrans has no Reddit footprint in English. The only hits are a Payhip release note listing it among eleven newly supported gateways and a developer's job posting. The Indonesian merchant conversation, if it exists, is not happening on Reddit.
